subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Does the v2026.7.1-beta.2/current-main reply-session package fix sufficiently cover the native iOS WebChat no-response symptom, or should this remain a separate native transport/session-routing issue?
rationale: The related package conflict is fixed in beta, but issue 97983 contains native iOS evidence where chat.send and dispatch were absent, so automation cannot safely infer closure without app-path proof or maintainer scoping.

options.title: Keep pending iOS proof
options.body: Keep 97983 open until a real native iOS/WebChat send on current main or v2026.7.1-beta.2 proves chat.send, dispatch, assistant final persistence, and app-visible reply all succeed.

options.title: Close as covered by beta
options.body: Close only if maintainers have external native iOS proof showing the beta reply-session package fix eliminates this exact no-response path.

options.title: Move to route-ownership tracker
options.body: If the remaining failure is restart-recovery boot takeover rather than native transport, route follow-up to #99346 and close this as duplicate with proof.

recommendation.title: Keep pending iOS proof
recommendation.body: Keep 97983 open until a real native iOS/WebChat send on current main or v2026.7.1-beta.2 proves chat.send, dispatch, assistant final persistence, and app-visible reply all succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and the strongest available owner signal for the native app and gateway chat boundary in this shallow checkout.
